units.time_s: seconds from the start of each analysed window (H10 device clock)

context.rest: rest before a 5 km rowing time trial (~82 bpm)
context.exercise: sprint finish of the same 5 km rowing time trial (~175 bpm)

beats_note: sample indices are 0-based rows of ecg_<panel>.csv; empty qrs_on/off = no segment found (the fiducial is used instead); rr_prev_ms = R-R to the previous detected beat.
